runs.cache_note: HOLON keeps no cache of kernel verdicts: bend2 (with BendTT re-checking) checks every proof file afresh. The toolchain job restored the cache under the lead's key (config/holon.json is the pack's bytes): toolchain binaries saved right after install, before any law ran, so no verdict could be memoized; no job log reports any reuse

failures.filter: holon replay-go ran (wrote replay/M3/goops/report.json, stamped 0 records); then holon refute --milestone M3 --only filter failed with FileNotFoundError for spec/M3/lib/refute.json, so holon sym --aggregate did not run either. refute.json is I40's refuter instrument and holds the lead's law statuses, so it cannot be given to a blind tree. Neither stage sets a status: the filter bins REFUTED records' witnesses, and the aggregate rebuilds SYM's split documents, races.json and replay report from the records
